messages:
anna_csm: Heads-up — following last night's inference degradation, we need a short consolidated status update + proposed office hours for affected mid-market accounts. Goal: reassure, share mitigation, capture blockers and ask if they'd like a dedicated walkthrough.
emma_cs: OK — I can draft the outbound note. Do we want unified language for renewal-risk accounts vs standard impacted? :thinking_face:
patrick_eng: Quick update from eng: root cause was a KV-cache eviction bug that showed up with long-running Dedicated sessions. Fix deployed 03:10 UTC, rolling validation passed. Full RCA being written.
liam_ops: Incident page updated: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2887654321 — added timeline and mitigation steps.
jordan_se: For office hours — suggest two slots Wed 15:00 UTC and Thu 01:00 UTC to cover EMEA + NA. I can host one with Emma.
anna_csm: @emma_cs + @jordan_se — please include an explicit ask for customers to share any recent prompt sets that regressed and whether they saw increased lat/5xx.
emma_cs: Draft outbound (short):

"Hi <CustomerName>,

We wanted to let you know about an incident last night that briefly affected inference latency and 5xx rates for a subset of Dedicated/Dedicated-burst pools. The engineering team deployed a fix and we validated rollout; the service is stable now.

What we’re doing: rolling RCA, offering office hours to review any impact on your workloads, and applying a small service credit for affected windows.

Would you like to join an office hours session? Proposed slots: Wed 15:00 UTC, Thu 01:00 UTC. Reply here or click: https://calendly.com/redwood/cs-office-hours

Thanks,
Redwood Customer Success
"

emma_cs: Thoughts? keep tone short and actionable. :+1: :eyes:
patrick_eng: Add one line noting we reverted an experimental KV eviction heuristic; mention ETA for permanent hardening (2 weeks).
anna_csm: Good. For renewal-risk accounts, we should include a tailored note offering a 30-min technical deep dive + 1 month of extended observability retention for free. Emma — can you create a small variant for renewals?
emma_cs: Yep — I'll prepare two templates: general impacted + renewal-risk. Will ping when ready.
liam_ops: For credits: finance ok with pro-rata credit for the affected window. I'll generate the credit list and put as CSV in the shared drive.
jordan_se: Can we also add a short feedback ask in the note: one question — did this incident change your confidence to ship on Redwood in next 30 days? (scale 1-5). We can use answers to prioritize outreach.
anna_csm: Love that — captures renewal signal. Add to draft.
emma_cs: Uploaded drafts: https://drive.redwood.ai/CS/incident-notes/2887654321 — please review.
patrick_eng: RCA draft ETA EOD. Will include root cause, mitigation, planned follow-ups (kv heuristic rollback, autoscale guard rails, additional e2e tests).
liam_ops: Office hours invite created — https://meet.redwood.ai/rooms/office-hours-2887654321 — please add to outbound.
jordan_se: I'll triage top 10 renewal-risk accounts for personal outreach after drafts are final.
anna_csm: Thanks all. Action items recap:
- Emma: finalize two outbound templates + add feedback question (due in 2 hours)
- Patrick: RCA draft (EOD)
- Liam: credit list CSV + update finance (4 hours)
- Jordan: office hours host + triage renewal-risk top10 (by EOD)
- Anna: consolidate final note and post to incident page + send outbound to impacted list (after review)

Please react with :white_check_mark: when your item is done so I can close the loop.
incident-bot: Incident 2887654321 status changed to: postmortem_in_progress — https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2887654321
anna_csm: marking for follow-up next standup. Thanks everyone.
